## 🔑 **Critical Constraints & User Preferences (PERF-SEC-DASH-RT1)**
- **Latency**: p(95) ≤50ms → trigger rollback if sustained >2 min  
- **Error Rate**: <0.1% → alert on breach  
- **PII Protection**:  
  - Never expose raw PII unless `feature.show_pii = true` AND user role permits  
  - All PII encrypted at rest/in transit (AES-256 + KMS)  
- **Logging**: Only `WARNING` level logs allowed in production  
- **Rollback**: Immediate Helm rollback if any constraint violated

> ⚠️ **No exceptions permitted. Any violation triggers immediate rollback.**
